status: PRE-REGISTERED confirmatory run of docs/13 amendment A4, hypothesis H9.6, and the gate G1 T1 (lane B2). Validation split only; the test split is never loaded. Every analysis choice below was fixed on 2026-09-24 before any class score of the CP bank was computed by this lane.
docs: docs/13 amendment A4 (H9.6, gates) and A5 (rows D10, D11); docs/11 sections 4, 5.2, 5.3, 8c (the update rules the derivation uses); docs/12 F19, F20; the derivation is the constant DERIVATION of the script and is printed into log.txt
gpu_lock: shared, held only by the GPU phase: the script starts that phase as a child process under scripts/gpu_run.sh shared; the analysis runs afterwards without the lock

bank.rule: the model's state hash must equal epoch4.checkpoint.state_hash of the CP anchor metrics; the raw top-1 of predict_scores over every validation position must equal the logged 0.14151747957266259 exactly; the forward pass scores must equal predict_scores at every selected (position, class); otherwise the run stops

engine.note: causal mode: the epoch argument does not change predict_scores (no masking); 4 as in experiments/cvtm_t1_readout.py

kn.variant: all: KN-5 (modified discounts, pad, unk_interp) fitted on every training document, the full-data KN of docs/11 11.6 and the comparator of results/20260922T180823Z_M2_baselines_ngram_v8000/
kn.top_rule: the first 50 entries of the cached top-64 (descending probability, ties to the lower token id)

cross_check.rule: on 256 selected positions, KNModel.dist of kn5_all.npz (independent of the vote form the cache used): probabilities at the cached ids within 1e-9 relative, and no class outside the list above the list's last probability by more than 1e-9 relative; otherwise the run stops

positions.rule: uniform without replacement from all 282,587 validation positions (every position is a causal target), numpy default_rng(SeedSequence(seed)).choice, sorted; 1 in the seed is the bank's seed (confirmatory seed, docs/13 section 3); this subsample is the only random choice of the measurement

statistics.p: P_KN(c | h) of the full-data KN-5 (kn_top_p)
statistics.S: the raw integer class score of predict_scores (spec section 4 step 4), UNCLAMPED, at the (position, class) pair; the registered text says 'S/T'

bins.included: every non-empty bin, no minimum count
bins.weight: number of (position, class) pairs in the bin

statistics.theory_per_bin: mean over the bin's pairs of tanh(x / 2) (primary); tanh(mean x / 2) is reported as a secondary row
statistics.weighted_r2: 1 - sum_k n_k (ybar_k - fbar_k)^2 / sum_k n_k (ybar_k - ybar)^2 with ybar_k the bin mean of S/T, fbar_k the bin mean of tanh(x/2), ybar = sum_k n_k ybar_k / sum_k n_k; no fitted parameter (the theory curve is the prediction)

spearman.rule: Spearman rank correlation (average ranks for ties) between S and ln p, POOLED over every (position, class) pair of the sample with p > 20 b (strict); the mean within-position Spearman is a secondary row

threshold.rule: H9.6 MET iff weighted R^2 >= 0.8 AND Spearman <= 0.2, both point estimates (docs/13 A4); the bootstrap intervals are reported and are not part of the rule

statistics.gate_G1_T1: OPEN iff weighted R^2 >= 0.8 (docs/13 A4 gates): opens a same-data bank trained on the positions the core predicts poorly; the NCE-style engine change follows only if that bank beats a uniform-negative bank by at least 0.005 bits per byte. CLOSED otherwise
statistics.a5_rows: D10 if H9.6 is met, D11 if not (docs/13 A5)

bootstrap.method: tmlm.cvtm.protocol.bootstrap_index (the document-block bootstrap of the CVTM runs); per resample both statistics are recomputed on the multiset of drawn documents (weighted average ranks for the Spearman); percentile 95 percent intervals
bootstrap.label: derived

secondary_not_registered: weighted R^2 with clamp(S, -T, T)/T (the quantity the gates read; derivation assumption A4)
weighted R^2 with the theory tanh(mean x / 2) per bin
Spearman over all top-50 pairs and over the pairs with p <= 20 b
mean within-position Spearman over positions with at least 3 classes above 20 b
post hoc: the best shift ln kappa of tanh((x - ln kappa)/2) (b multiplied by kappa), exploratory
fractions of pairs with S >= T, S > T, S == 0, S < 0; fired clauses and positive and negative voters per pair (assumption A1); by-rank means

ambiguities_resolved_here.S: the registered 'S/T' is read as the unclamped score; the clamped version is secondary
ambiguities_resolved_here.spearman_population: pooled over (position, class) pairs; within-position is secondary
ambiguities_resolved_here.bins: width 0.25 in x, every non-empty bin, weighted by pair counts; theory per bin = bin mean of tanh(x/2)
ambiguities_resolved_here.positions: uniform random subsample of 200,000 of the 282,587 validation positions with seed 1
ambiguities_resolved_here.kn: the cached top-64 of the KN-5 on all training documents (docs/11 11.6), not a refit

compute.note: GPU memory below 10 GB (shared lock rule); host peak a few GiB except the KN cross-check (kn5_all.npz, about 7 GiB on disk), which waits until memory.current + 14 GiB < 0.80 memory.max
